column1: # THE SECOND WITNESS TO GILBERTO'S PARENTAGE - Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 10 September 1885.
# Folio 296. Priest: Pbro. Don Silverio Viola, by licence of the Cura Parroco; signed Rafael Yeregui.
# Index ark 1:1:6DFW-VY4P; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-BQZD-W. IMAGE READ 14 September 2026, level 12.
# *** WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN A SECOND COPY. *** Act 1447 of 1886 was read the day before, and it
# already made Gilberto a brother of Luis Eugenio. This act says the same thing from a DIFFERENT
# PARISH (the Catedral, not San Francisco de Asis), in a DIFFERENT YEAR, in a DIFFERENT PRIEST'S
# HAND. Two independent registers agreeing is a different kind of evidence from one register read

column3: *** He is the "Raul Lerena, b.1885 Montevideo" of the 1895 Buenos Aires census, in Gilberto's household. *** The census and the font now agree.

column2: 10 July 1885 - "que nacio el diez de Julio del presente ano"

column3: A second parish for this family, alongside San Francisco de Asis.

column2: hijo legitimo de GILBERTO LERENA y JULIA SALVANACH, ORIENTALES
column3: Both stated Uruguayan, as in act 1447.

*** IDENTICAL TO ACT 1447, AND TO LUIS EUGENIO'S OWN PARENTS *** in his marriage act of 1864, his death act of 1901 and his 1846 baptism. Four acts across fifty-five years, three parishes and four hands, all naming the same couple.

column2: abuelos maternos: CRISTOBAL y ANGELA ALVAREZ
column3: Agrees exactly with act 1447 - Julia Salvanach's parents.

column2: fueron padrinos: Alfredo Costa y *** JOSEFA LERENA ***
column3: *** A NEW LERENA. *** A woman of the surname standing godmother to Gilberto's son in 1885 - very likely another of the siblings, or a cousin. Nothing else in this archive names her.

column2: Pbro. Don Silverio Viola; signed Rafael Yeregui
column3: Neither hand appears anywhere else in this archive. Act 1447 was Martin Perez.
